scientific_limitations: Only three consecutive ordinary pentagonal numbers for integer n>=2. Exhaustive finite certificate rests on separately proved cutoff n>=142. Prior OEIS A069757 contains the Frobenius values and is not claimed novel. Equivalence not excluded in unindexed sources.
title: Exactly four symmetric semigroups among consecutive pentagonal triples
